newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CMC buys 4.9 mln JCI shares.
newsitem.headline: CMC buys 4.9 mln JCI shares.

text.p: Consolidated Mining Corp Ltd announced on Monday it had acquired 4.9 million ordinary shares in JCI Ltd in a deal worth 226.7 million rand.
CMC warned permanent capital holders that further negotiations were taking place and urged them to exercise caution in dealing in their units until a further announcement.

The JCI shares were priced at 4,600 cents each and the deal saw these shares acquired in exchange for 283.3 million ordinary shares of one cents each in CMC at 80 cents per share, being a consideration of 226.669 million rand.
"The acquisition is consistent with CMC's investment philosophy of enlarging its asset base through the acquisition of core strategic holdings in the mining sector," the company said.

CMC's net asset value per permanent capital unit at September 30, 1996 was 21.7 cents per unit. Had the acquisition been implemented on that date the net asset value would have been 37.3 cents per unit.
